freeze_requirements: A separate immutable protocol must pin the clean committed source base, compiler fingerprint over every source byte it reads, exact engine gitlink and clean checkout, complete transitive Python tool path/digest inventory, host, FRI/PoW settings, generated source and assignment digests, admitted general mixed profile and sealed component manifest, split menus, gates and model algorithm before native build; external protocol SHA/anchor timestamp must precede training; external model SHA/anchor timestamp must precede held-out build.

v7r1_diagnostic_disclosure.use_of_v7r1_validation: motivated the prospective uncertainty method and size-stratified design only; no V7r1 held-out trial, coefficient, interval, or gate result may enter V8 fitting or calibration

rss_uncertainty.center_fit: V7 family-specific point fits, refit from fresh V8 training observations only
rss_uncertainty.calibration: For each training program, fit the center on other V8 training programs, collect every trial residual, and take max(abs(p05),abs(p95)); radius is max of those absolute radii, their residual-to-center relative radii times the prediction center, and the fixed absolute floor. Clip lower at zero.

paired_mixed_vs_generic.comparison: same committed semantic S31 source, same assignment and public claim; separate generic and authenticated-general-mixed packages and native verifiers
paired_mixed_vs_generic.order: deterministic balanced AB/BA order, 50 assignments each; record order and process start times
paired_mixed_vs_generic.summary: per-pair median log(generic/mixed) and 95% paired bootstrap interval, paired by assignment; report absolute costs too
